
# 4. Prioritisation of Functionality – First Tranche (Year 1)

## Tranche 1 Objective

The first tranche focuses on establishing a minimum viable ecosystem workflow framework that demonstrates adaptability, reproducibility, FAIR compliance and practical applicability across multiple ecosystem indicator use cases. It delivers the foundation required for future workflow expansion while supporting the project's first reporting milestone and initial workflow deployment activities.
